That is not weird at all.]}} |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Dr. Emmett&f: May you lead a fulfilling life!}} |- | class="ct" | None |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] Dr. Emmett&f: It's you again. &eSelect an option:&a [Open your shop]&7 [I have a few questions...] }} |} == Lore == === Story === After the [[Calamity|{{DarkRed|Calamity}}]] took the life of [[Lathrop]]'s parents, '''Dr. Emmett''' adopted him. He was interested in studying [[The Breach]] that also came from the Calamity. One day, over thirty years after the Calamity, he asked Lathrop to deliver a letter with details regarding his experiment to his colleague in the {{Zone|Wilderness}}. The letter however, was never delivered, since Lathrop went to {{Red|The Catacombs}} with [[Necron]] and became [[The Watcher]]. Since Lathrop never delivered the letter, '''Dr. Emmett''' asked [[Alatar]] to summon a copy of it. He threw the letter into the breach, which caused an event that transformed him into the [[Rift Dimension]], to be forever stuck there. He continues his study from inside of the [[Rift]] as the first human to enter this dimension, unfortunately he is forever stuck there. == Trivia == *'''Dr. Emmett''' is one of a few NPCs who are not originally from [[Rift Dimension]], alongside {{NPCSprite|Julian}}, {{NPCSprite|Barry}}, {{NPCSprite|Alatar}} and {{NPCSprite|Tel Kar}}. *'''Dr. Emmett''' and [[The Watcher]]'s names are references to Dr. Emmett Lathrop Brown, also known as Doc, from ''Back to the Future'': in the lore, The Watcher's original name was Lathrop. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2023/May 4|[[File:Dr. Emmett.png|26px]] Added '''Dr. Emmett'''.}} |beta= {{History|2023/Feb 16|Added more Dungeon Journals, including The Follower, featuring '''Dr. Emmett'''.}} {{History|0.19|[[File:Dr. Emmett.png|26px]] Added '''Dr. Emmett'''.}} }}
